assert: C1 negative control: all 48 concurrent workers completed without error and every round's completion counter reads 16
C1 with 1 unit(s) left, exactly 1 of 16 simultaneous pre-checks is admitted in every round and the scope ends at 2 units
C2 negative control: all 48 concurrent workers completed without error and every round's completion counter reads 16
C2 with 0 unit(s) left, exactly 0 of 16 simultaneous pre-checks is admitted in every round and the scope ends at 2 units
C3 negative control: every round's completion counter reads 8, no worker error
C3 8 simultaneous requests firing K1 (credited, 2 units of room) and K2 churn (no credit): none admitted and NO unit taken on K1 or globally in any round (contrast #115 G06 C4 over-spend)
C4 negative control: every round's completion counter reads 16, no worker error
C4 16 simultaneous pre-checks over 8 credited scopes (16 units of scope room): exactly 12 admitted (the global epoch tier) in every round
C5 negative control: every round's completion counter reads 16, no worker error

C5 a 16-way burst of credited colleagues (pre-check + success) on a scope with 2 units: at least 2 are admitted; the first refusal persists the S0 K1 block, so the rest are denied (legitimate-concurrency limit); units never exceed 2 or go negative, the global tier mirrors the scope, and a unit stays spent only for an admitted attempt whose success met the persisted block (S0 ordering: such an outcome is not resolved)
C6 negative control: every round's completion counter reads 8, no worker error
C6 the same success replayed by 8 workers at once resolves the tuple once: 2 units before, exactly 0 after (one own unit + one recorded failure returned; never negative, never more)
C7 a success arriving after its tuple expired returns nothing (1 unit stays), and a success for a reservation of an expired epoch is never credited into the new epoch (stays 1)
C8 negative control: every round's completion counter reads 16, no worker error

C8 two unresolved reservations taken under the old secret count after rotation: none of 16 simultaneous pre-checks under the new secret is admitted, and a success of an old reservation leaves the old generation at 2 units (never written, never reset)
T1 every Redis key written by the concurrent bursts has a TTL
